basic_info.description: Outer Parkside Jewel Box! On the market for the first time in decades, this classic home checks all the right boxes! A south-facing floor plan fills the space with natural light, highlighting the beautifully refinished hardwood floors throughout the main level. The open living and dining area, complete with a charming corner fireplace, creates a warm and inviting atmosphere.  The updated kitchen features granite countertops, brand-new appliances (all under warranty), ample cabinetry, and an eat-in bar counter, making it both stylish and functional. Two comfortable bedrooms sit off the hallway, along with a vintage-inspired full bath. Downstairs, the expansive garage offers parking for two cars, a laundry area, and abundant storage. With great potential for future expansion, this space invites endless possibilities. Step outside to a spacious backyard with a level patio, surrounded by new landscaping. Located in a prime Outer Parkside location, you're minutes from Highway 1, multiple MUNI lines (including the L-Taraval Metro), and fantastic outdoor destinations like Lake Merced, Harding Park, Ocean Beach, Great Highway, Fort Funston and SF Zoo. The neighborhood is sprinkled with great cafs, restaurants, and the convenience of Lakeshore Plaza for all your shopping needs.
